description: Use when the user asks whether a piece of writing sounds like AI, wants an email, post, essay or cover letter checked for chatbot habits before sending, or wants to know which phrases to fix. Returns a 0-100 score, a verdict, and each habit found (chatbot words like "delve" and "tapestry", "not X, it's Y" framing, em-dash overuse, assistant filler, fake suspense, stiff transitions, markdown leftovers and more) with examples and why readers notice it. It is a habit check, not an AI detector, and short texts give rough scores. Example: {"text": "<the draft to check>"}. To rewrite, use your own judgment on the flagged habits.

text.description: The writing to check (up to 60,000 characters).

name: tells_check_writing
title: Check writing for AI-sounding habits
